title: Xiaomi unveils the Xring O100, a 6nm AI accelerator to boost its MiMo models when paired with its O3 mobile chip, and the 3nm Xring D100 for autonomous driving (Iris Deng/South China Morning Post)
summary: Iris Deng / South China Morning Post: Xiaomi unveils the Xring O100, a 6nm AI accelerator to boost its MiMo models when paired with its O3 mobile chip, and the 3nm Xring D100 for autonomous driving — Chinese tech giant's Xring O3 3nm AI processor scheduled to debut aboard folding smartphone in September
